chunks: And in the narration of Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
The waiting period (ʿiddah) of the bondwoman who does not menstruate is forty-five nights.

key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ: Samāʿah, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.عِدَّةُ: the prescribed waiting period after separation

ai.seo_question: What is the ʿiddah of a bondwoman who does not menstruate in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the ʿiddah of a bondwoman who does not menstruate. It specifies that her waiting period is forty-five nights, making it a concise legal text in the area of family law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4867 - In the narration of Samaʿah from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:
"The waiting period (ʿiddah) of a bondwoman who does not menstruate is forty-five nights."
